spaces.module.name: Room bookings
spaces.module.description: Members ask for a room or a shared resource, such as a van, at a time and for a purpose. Each request is confirmed at once, sent to a room manager to decide, or refused by a rule, and two confirmed bookings never overlap.
spaces.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change room booking settings
spaces.settings.bookings.slot-size.label: Booking times fall on steps of
spaces.settings.bookings.slot-size.help: Every start and end is a multiple of this many minutes. Raising it later does not move bookings already made.
spaces.settings.bookings.max-length.help: Where neither the room nor the purpose sets its own limit.
spaces.settings.bookings.max-ahead.label: How far ahead a booking may start
spaces.settings.bookings.max-ahead.help: Where the purpose does not set its own.
spaces.settings.bookings.min-notice.labe: Least notice before a booking starts
spaces.settings.bookings.min-notice.help: Where the purpose does not set its own. Nothing means a booking may start straight away.
spaces.settings.bookings.cancel-notice.l: Cancelling later than this is a late cancellation
spaces.settings.bookings.cancel-notice.h: A late cancellation is noted, and a room manager sees it when deciding that person's requests.
spaces.settings.bookings.keep-for.label: Keep bookings after they end for
spaces.settings.bookings.keep-for.help: Then they are removed. Shortening this lets the next clear-out remove bookings that would otherwise have been kept.
spaces.settings.series.max-occurrences.l: Most bookings in one repeating series
spaces.settings.series.max-occurrences.h: A series is every date of a weekly rehearsal, say, booked in one go.
spaces.settings.requests.remind-after.la: Remind room managers about a request after
spaces.settings.requests.remind-after.he: A request still waiting this long joins the daily reminder, and is marked urgent once its start is this close.
spaces.settings.bumping.enabled.label: A higher-priority request may displace a booking
spaces.settings.bumping.enabled.help: Always through a room manager, with notice. Off means only a performance or a closure ever displaces a booking.
spaces.settings.bumping.notice.label: A booking starting sooner than this cannot be displaced
spaces.settings.bumping.notice.help: By a request. A performance or a closure still displaces it.
spaces.settings.bumping.contact.label: Who a displaced person should talk to
spaces.settings.bumping.contact.help: A role or a desk, such as the Theatre Manager, not a private person. It is named in the message they receive.
spaces.settings.calendar.show-details.la: What members see of each other's bookings
spaces.settings.calendar.show-details.he: Room managers always see everything, and everyone always sees their own.
spaces.settings.calendar.show-details.op: What it is for, its title and who booked it
Only that the time is booked
spaces.settings.calendar.day-starts.labe: First hour shown on the calendar
spaces.settings.calendar.day-starts.help: Bookings earlier than this are still listed.
spaces.settings.calendar.day-ends.label: Last hour shown on the calendar
spaces.settings.calendar.day-ends.help: Bookings later than this are still listed.
spaces.settings.reminders.before.label: Remind the booker before their booking
spaces.settings.no-show.window.label: A no-show can be marked or cleared for
spaces.settings.no-show.window.help: Counted from when the booking ends.
spaces.navigation.bookables.label: Rooms and resources
spaces.navigation.purposes.label: Purposes
spaces.abilities.bookable.manage.label: Set up rooms and resources for booking
spaces.abilities.purpose.manage.label: Set up what rooms are booked for
spaces.bookables.description: Choose which spaces can be booked, and add shared things such as a van or a piano. Spaces themselves are added and renamed in the programme.
spaces.bookables.empty.title: No spaces yet
spaces.bookables.empty.description: Add a venue and its spaces in the programme, then come back to make them bookable.
spaces.bookables.resources-help: Shared things with a diary of their own, such as a van, a piano or a projector.
spaces.bookables.name: Name
spaces.bookables.name-help: What people book it as, such as Van or Rehearsal piano.
spaces.bookables.home-venue-help: A closure of this venue stops it being booked.
spaces.bookables.control.label: Who runs it
spaces.bookables.contact-help: The people who run it, such as the Students' Union room bookings desk. Every booking here is a request we place with them.
spaces.bookables.approval-note-help: Shown on the booking form before anything is typed, such as how long an answer usually takes.
spaces.bookable.external-space: Someone else runs this room, so every booking is a request we place with them. Whether we run a space is set in the programme.
spaces.bookable.approval.label: Approval
spaces.bookable.approval.help: Each purpose says whether its bookings need approval; this can ask for approval of every booking here.
spaces.bookable.approval.external-help: Every booking of a room run by someone else is a request, whatever this says.
spaces.bookable.guidance-help: Shown to people booking, such as where the key is kept or what to leave as you found it.
spaces.bookable.max-length-help: A purpose's own limit applies where this is the theatre's.
spaces.bookable.moved.paused: {name} paused: it takes no new bookings, and what is booked stands
spaces.hours.always-open-help: Bookings can be made at any hour of any day.
spaces.hours.midnight: A room open past midnight closes at 00:00 and opens again from 00:00 on the next day. Changing the hours never moves a booking already made.
spaces.purposes.description: What a room may be booked for. When two bookings want the same time, the one with the higher tier wins; tier 1 is the highest. Performances and closures always win.
spaces.purposes.empty.title: No purposes yet
spaces.purposes.empty.description: Start from the list that is nearest to how your theatre works, and change it as you like. Or add your own.
spaces.purposes.lists.student-society.de: Any member may ask; one person decides each request.
spaces.purposes.lists.amateur-company.de: Rehearsals and meetings are confirmed at once.
spaces.purposes.lists.small-venue.name: Small venue
spaces.purposes.lists.small-venue.descri: Staff book the rooms, including hires.
spaces.purposes.tier-help: A higher tier may displace a lower one, where priority is on.
spaces.purposes.tier-changed: Bookings already made keep their priority.
spaces.purposes.order.help: Within a tier, drag a purpose by its handle to change the order people see, or press Space on the handle and use the arrow keys.
spaces.purposes.name: Name
spaces.purposes.open-to.label: Who can choose it
spaces.purposes.approval.label: Approval
spaces.purposes.approval.help: A room can ask for approval of a purpose that is confirmed at once elsewhere.
spaces.purposes.needs-production-help: The booking says which production it is for. Always on for a production's team.
spaces.purposes.max-ahead: Days ahead it can be booked
spaces.purposes.may-repeat: Can be booked as a repeating booking
spaces.purposes.can-be-bumped: Can be displaced by a higher tier
spaces.purposes.can-be-bumped-help: Performances and closures displace any booking.
spaces.purposes.never-bumped: Never displaced by a higher tier
spaces.purposes.retired-toast: {name} retired: bookings made for it keep it
